title: Spectral Analysis of Weighted Weyl Fractional Operators: Aging, Infinite Memory, and the Amnesia Effect
summary: This paper establishes a rigorous spectral framework for the Weighted Weyl Fractional Calculus, designed to model non-local systems exhibiting aging and subjective time scales. By constructing a conjugation map involving a time-dependent weight $ω(t)$ and a scale function $ψ(t)$, we define a new class of fractional operators that preserve the spectral tractability of time-invariant systems.
